title: 🏘️ Eryndor Living Atlas XIII — Sixfold Settlement & Throne Population Register
rawNotionMarkup: SUPPLEMENTARY SETTLEMENT AUDIT — NOT A COMPETING POPULATION REGISTER. The authoritative current sixfold census and full local tallies are held at Eryndor Living Census XII — Sixfold Population & Carrying-Capacity Audit. This appendix independently cross-checks named-settlement arithmetic; defer to Living Census XII in case of disagreement. All values are a coherent rescaling of previously simulated figures, not a migration event; seasonal populations and unnamed/unverified censuses are treated separately. Existing geography and political authority remain, while settlement function and logistics need a later survey. ## Named settlements and Thrones — revised population register All counts below are approximately six times the earlier simulated residents; names and political assignments remain unchanged. Settlement categories (hamlet, village, town, city) are subject to reclassification at these sizes. The earlier seven Throne figures are domain-level population envelopes that are not additive to their constituent cities or satellite villages. Karak-Varn's historical figure is used for the wider capital/metropolitan population: care is required in its surrounding domain census to prevent counting the same Khazari twice. Exact district/realm boundaries and density await mapping. 'Seasonal' is attendance or temporary population, not an additional set of permanent residents. Population is an average planning baseline, not a promise that every settlement can remain sustainable under siege or drought. ### The Seven Great Mountain Thrones — precise regional seats | Settlement or domain | Previous | 6× current | Accounting note | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Karak-Varn | 3,800,000 | 22,800,000 | Throne/domain envelope; Separate temporary assemblies and seasonal festivals from year-round residents. Overlapping Metro/Throne/domain and adjacent mixed-settlement populations are nested subcounts, never sums of independent populations. Underwater Merfolk cities are part of the existing five-continent coastal attribution in the species matrix and must not be double counted under surface-city totals. Re-evaluate resource carrying capacity rather than quietly lowering a chosen sixfold population: strained settlements can import, reform, migrate, suffer or recover within the living simulation, subject to their actual history. All former numbers remain in the old atlas for audit. ## Ecology and continuity Established cultural-magic, marriage, biology, fertility, lifespans, kings, existing city names, road sequence and the Gloin campaign do not change from this demographic editorial revision. The First Throne and its possible historical 40m population are not 'current Throne residents'. Do not convert all isolated wilderness to farmland just to justify these place counts. 50,000-km world, 60/40 water/land, Fifth Age, Era of Crowns Year 3847 and current suspended Autumn Day 22, 11:25 AM scene are the context.
